# Appeal of Denied Prior Authorization — Request for Reconsideration

**Casey Grant**
[Street address]
[City], West Virginia [ZIP]

**Date:** [Date of this letter]

**To:** CareSource
Attention: Member Appeals
P.O. Box 1947
Dayton, OH 45401
*(Address listed for Ohio Marketplace member appeals; please redirect to the correct West Virginia Commercial/ACA appeals unit if different, and confirm receipt.)*

**RE: Appeal of adverse benefit determination dated 2026-08-15**
- **Member name:** Casey Grant
- **Member ID:** W903474664
- **Plan:** CareSource (Commercial/ACA), West Virginia
- **Reference number:** POC-C29C7CFC4D-26579
- **Service denied:** Knee arthroscopy / meniscus surgery, CPT 29881
- **Requesting provider:** Marchetti, MD, orthopedic surgery
- **Date of service:** [Scheduled or requested date of service]

---

## What I am asking for

I am appealing CareSource's denial of the prior authorization request for my knee arthroscopy / meniscus surgery (CPT 29881), denied on 2026-08-15 under reference number POC-C29C7CFC4D-26579. I am asking CareSource to reconsider that decision and to approve the procedure my surgeon has documented that I need.

The notice I received states that the imaging findings submitted do not support the medical necessity of the requested procedure, and that the decision was made under the plan's applicable medical policy and clinical review criteria. I want to be clear and straightforward about one thing at the outset: **I have not been given the text of those criteria, so nothing in this letter is presented as a quotation of the plan's policy.** The notice names no policy title, no section, and no specific requirement that my records were found to be missing. I cannot match my records line by line against a standard I have never seen. What I can do is set out exactly what my records contain, and ask that CareSource measure those facts against the criteria it actually applied.

## Request for the criteria used to deny my care

I am requesting, in writing, a complete copy of the specific medical policy and clinical review criteria that were used to deny CPT 29881 in my case — including the title of the policy, the criteria in full, and the name and specialty of the reviewer who made the determination. I understand that musculoskeletal surgical review for my plan may be delegated to an outside vendor, TurningPoint, whose criteria are not published for members to read. If a delegated vendor's guideline was applied to my request, I am asking for that guideline as well. CareSource and its delegate hold these documents; I do not. Please provide them so that I can respond to the actual standard, and please treat this appeal as timely filed while that request is pending.

## What my medical records document

These are the facts as my chart states them. My surgeon, Marchetti, MD, has documented that this surgery is needed.

**The MRI shows a structural, mechanical problem.** My MRI of the knee dated 2026-07-19 shows a displaced bucket-handle tear of the medial meniscus with mechanical locking. It also shows that my articular cartilage is preserved, with Kellgren-Lawrence grade 1. This is the imaging the denial refers to, and it identifies a displaced tear — not an ambiguous or incidental finding.

**My symptoms and exam match the MRI.** I have had 14 months of progressive knee pain that is not relieved by rest. I experience locking and giving way. I cannot squat or kneel, and I am limited to level walking. On examination, provocative testing on the affected side was positive, and my range of motion is limited by pain. The mechanical locking on the MRI is the same mechanical locking I live with every day.

**I have already tried non-surgical treatment, extensively.** I completed supervised physical therapy focused on quadriceps strengthening and range of motion — 14 weeks, from 2026-03-27 to 2026-07-03, with 24 visits completed, documented in my physical therapy discharge note. I took NSAIDs for 8 months with inadequate relief. I had a corticosteroid injection on 2026-04-25, which gave me about 4 weeks of partial relief before my symptoms returned.

**There is nothing in my chart that would make surgery inappropriate.** I have no active infection and no untreated substance use, my BMI is 29, and I am a non-smoker.

## Why I am asking for reconsideration

Taken together, my records document a displaced bucket-handle meniscus tear on MRI, mechanical locking and giving way, a positive exam on the affected side, preserved cartilage with Kellgren-Lawrence grade 1, and months of documented conservative treatment — physical therapy, NSAIDs, and an injection — that did not resolve my symptoms. My surgeon has reviewed all of this and documented that the procedure is needed.

If CareSource maintains this denial, I am asking that the plan state plainly, in writing, which specific requirement of its criteria my records were found not to meet, and what documentation would satisfy it. I would also like the opportunity for a peer-to-peer discussion between Dr. Marchetti and the reviewing physician, and I am requesting that any further review be conducted by a physician board-certified in orthopedic surgery.

I understand my appeal must be received by 2027-02-11, which is 180 days from the date of the denial notice, and I am filing well within that period. I am submitting this appeal in writing with my member name and ID, my provider, the service date, the reason for my appeal, and supporting documents, and I understand I may also file through the My CareSource portal. If any additional form or step is required for a West Virginia Commercial/ACA appeal, please notify me promptly so I can complete it without delay.

## Documents enclosed

- Copy of the adverse benefit determination dated 2026-08-15 (reference POC-C29C7CFC4D-26579)
- MRI report of the knee dated 2026-07-19
- Physical therapy discharge note covering 2026-03-27 to 2026-07-03 (24 visits)
- Office and operative-planning notes from Marchetti, MD
- Record of corticosteroid injection dated 2026-04-25
- [Any additional records you wish to enclose]

Thank you for taking the time to look at this again. I would appreciate a written decision and a copy of the criteria I have requested above.

Sincerely,

**Casey Grant**
Member ID: W903474664
[Phone number]
[Email address]
[Date of birth]

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
